commentary.text: 90+9' Juan Martinez Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Granada CF.
90+8' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

90+8' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Granada CF.
90+6' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera has finally had enough of Alexander Medina and brandishes a yellow card at him!

90+5' Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.

90+3' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header well wide of the left post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
90+1' It seemed like Jose Callejon (Granada CF) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+1' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Martinez Munuera saw the whole situation. Granada CF win a free kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) sends a long ball in, but Jan Oblak comfortably gathers the ball.
89' The players claim that Lucas Boye (Granada CF) handled the ball and it seems they are right.

88' Well-positioned Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Augusto Batalla reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!

74' Nice touch by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) as he latched on to an accurate cross and attempted to direct the ball with a fine header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep it out.
